idea: Binance (and per HyroTrader's FAQ, Bybit for tokenised stocks / metals) lists TradFi perps (SPY, QQQ, IWM, TLT, XAU, XAG, CL, BZ, NATGAS, COPPER, ...); the futures book (results/futures_book_rebuild.parquet, Gen205-221, 10% vol, corr about 0.05 with crypto) as a sleeve inside the crypto book

trials.A futures book as a sleeve: daily futures-book return booked in the 21:00 UTC hour of its date, minus a perp funding drag of 4% a year (of the 10%-vol sleeve; Binance default funding 0.01% / 8 h is about 11% a year on longs vs about 4-5% financing already in futures returns, on an average net long notional of about 0.6), then added through portfolio_v5 (equal risk)

feasibility_caveat: which of the book's markets the firm's exchange lists (bonds, energy spreads like HO seasonality need futures) decides whether it can run; a pass here means 'worth building a perp-only version', not adoption
